description: This Dart file defines a BudgetRepository class responsible for managing budget data in a SQLite database within a Flutter application. It includes methods for retrieving budgets for a specific month, inserting or updating budget entries, and calculating total amounts by category for a given month.

classes.name: BudgetRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing budget data interactions with the database.

methods.name: getBudgetsForMonth
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BudgetModel instances for a specified month.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts a new budget or updates an existing one based on category and month.

methods.name: totalsByCategoryForMonth
methods.description: Calculates total transaction amounts grouped by category for a specified month.
